narration.en: She covered her message in black. Then invited the visitor closer.
narration.zh: 她把字全塗黑，還請訪客靠近。

narration.en: The invitation was for tonight. There was no spare block.
narration.zh: 邀請是今晚要用的，也沒有備用木板。

narration.en: A chipped corner. Letters facing the wrong way.
narration.zh: 角落缺了一塊，字母的方向也反了。

narration.en: Was she hiding a mistake? She kept the clean paper dry.
narration.zh: 她是在掩飾錯誤嗎？乾淨的紙一直沒沾墨。

narration.en: Now every letter had vanished into black.
narration.zh: 現在，每個字都消失在一片黑裡。

narration.en: She pressed the paper onto the raised letters, then peeled it back.
narration.zh: 她把紙壓在凸字上，再揭開。

narration.en: The ruined message was the printing surface. This was her first invitation.
narration.zh: 被毀掉的字其實是印面，這才是第一張邀請。
